chunks: On that Day they will be dragged into the fire faces foremost, (and told:) 'Taste the feel of Hell.'
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about how disbelievers will be punished in Hell?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Qamar (54:48) is often cited to illustrate the physical and spiritual humiliation of the disbelievers, contrasting their upright posture in worldly life with their prostrate, face-dragged state in the Hereafter. The command 'Taste the touch of Hell' (Dhūqū mas Saqar) emphasizes the immediate, sensory reality of divine retribution, a concept frequently linked to the concept of *Barzakh* and the final judgment in Shia theological discourse.
